blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: ufakzeka-karar is an open Turkish decision model with 182,494,466 parameters. Given a Turkish text and questions of a fixed answer type (a choice, a level on an ordered scale, or yes or no), it returns a temperature-scaled probability for every option and an expected error that serves as a “not sure” signal, without generating text and in one CPU forward pass for up to ten options. Built on the lab’s ufakzeka-1-base, its head scores each option blind to the others at shared positions, so the answer does not depend on option order. A sequential head trained with shuffled options was about as accurate but changed 2.3 to 2.8 percent of its answers when only the option order changed; REINFORCE lost 10.2 points (0.102) of macro F1 to cross-entropy. On the open set of HakemBench v1.0 (4,275 questions, 7 tracks) the released model ranks 7th of 16 rows with a composite of 0.660 (95% interval 0.642 to 0.677). Temperature scaling lowers calibration error (smooth ECE) on the development set but raises it on held-out support questions, from 0.027 to 0.045 for the first scored run, which never trained on them; the released model later trained on them, so its 0.036 to 0.064 is not an unseen-question test. The released model is the last of three runs scored on HakemBench, and its numbers are not blind. The second run’s new training data was aimed at the first run’s errors on the full test set in guardrails, moderation and customer support, and the released run was trained after the second run’s guardrail results on the full test set were read, under a protocol fixed in writing before any of its data, code or runs. All its numbers come after these readings; its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers carry the flag “shaped by reading the test results”. With every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16. Weights and code are under Apache-2.0.
blocks.zh: ufakzeka-karar是一个开放的土耳其决定模型,有182,494,466个参数. 鉴于土耳其文本和固定回答类型的问题(一个选择,一个按顺序大小排列的级别,或者是或否),它返回每个选项的温度级概率,以及一个作为“不确定”信号的预期出错,而不产生文本,并在一个CPU中通过最多10个选项。 在实验室的Ufakzeka-1-base上建起,其头部的分数是每个选项在共享位置上对其他人视而不见,因此答案并不取决于选项顺序. 一个经过洗牌选项训练的相继头大约准确,但当只更改了选项顺序时,将答案的2.3%改为了2.8%;REINFORCE损失了10.2分(0.102分)的宏F1到跨入. 在Hakem Bench v1.0(4,275个问题,7个音轨)的开放集上,所发行的模型以0.660分(95%的间隔为0.642至0.677分)的组合排行第7. 温度缩放会降低开发集的校正误差(smooth ECE),但在被搁置的支援问题上则会提高,第一次得分的跑从0.027到0.045,这些赛跑从未对其进行过训练;释放出的模式后来对他们进行了训练,因此它的0.036到0.064并不是一个隐蔽的质疑测试. 所发行的模型是哈克姆·本奇(Hakem Bench)上三跑得分中的最后一场,其数字并非盲目. 第二跑的新训练数据针对的是第一跑在护栏、节制和客户支持的全测试装置上的错误,第二跑的护栏结果在全测试装置上被读取后,在任何数据、代码或运行之前,根据书面固定的协议,释放的跑被培训。 它的所有数字都是在这些读数之后出现的;它的护栏、节制和客户支持数字都悬挂着“通过阅读测试结果而成的”旗帜。 由于其他四道赛道上每个赛道只得分,其复合赛分数为0.678分,为16分之6. 重量和代码在Apache-2.0下.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language models are also used for decisions with a fixed set of answers, such as routing a support ticket, flagging a phishing message, grading an answer or stopping a prompt injection. A typed-decision interface, defined by the hosted decision API Jev [ 3 ] and followed by open models built for English or for many languages at once [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] , fixes the answer type in advance and returns a probability for every allowed answer. The probabilities are the product: a caller acts on the answers above a threshold and sends the rest to a person [ 21 ] , which works only as well as the probabilities are calibrated. A CPU model can run on the caller’s own machine, so the text need not leave it.
blocks.zh: 语言模型也被用于有固定的一组答案的决定,如路由支持票,标出打字留言,分级回答或停止即时注射等. 按主机决定 API Jev [3] 定义的打入决定界面,并随即为英语或多语言构建了开放模型[4,5,6,7],提前修正答案类型并返回每个被允许的答案的概率. 概率是出产:一个呼叫者在超过一个阈值的答案上行为,然后将其余的发送给一个人[21],它只起作用,概率也被校正. CPU模型可以在呼叫者自己的机器上运行,因此文本不需要离开.

blocks.en: ufakzeka-karar is a small model of this kind for Turkish, built on the lab’s first model [ 1 ] . We make four contributions: (i) an open model that answers a typed question in a median of 102.5 ms on one CPU thread; (ii) the order-invariant construction of Set-LLM [ 9 ] applied to a typed-decision head and measured against reinforcement learning and against a sequential head that reads the options one after another and was trained with shuffled options; (iii) calibration measured on support questions held out of Run 1’s training, including where it fails; and (iv) a comparison on HakemBench, the Turkish typed-decision benchmark of a companion paper [ 2 ] , with its disclosures: the model ranks 7th of 16 rows, and its training data and final run were shaped by reading earlier runs’ results on the full test set. Result numbers trace to result files committed in the project’s repository; internal audit figures, such as the hand-checked samples, are reported as recorded. Each selection and acceptance rule was written down before its result was seen. Square brackets give 95 percent bootstrap intervals throughout.
blocks.zh: ufakzeka-karar是土耳其人这种小型模型,建立在实验室的第一个模型上[1]. 我们做出了四项贡献:(一) 一个开放式模型,在一个CPU线上以102.5 ms的中位数回答一个打出的问题;(二) Set-LLM[9] 的顺序不固定构造适用于一个打出的决定头,并对照一个逐个读取各种选择的相继头来测量; (三) 根据Run 1 培训中掌握的支持问题,包括培训失败之处,测量的校正;(四) 对土耳其打出的决定基准Hakem Bench的比较,一份配套文件[2],及其披露:模型排行第7位,其培训数据和最终运行是通过阅读在全套测试中得出的结果。 结果数字可追溯到项目存放处所承诺的结果档案;内部审计数字,如手工核对的样本,作为记录报告。 每项选择和接受规则在看到结果之前都写下来。 平方括号的长度为95%。

blocks.en: We follow Jev’s public contract [ 3 ] : up to 255 options for a choice question and 2 to 10 ordered levels for a score question. Kev [ 4 ] trains low-rank adapters and a pointer head on Qwen3.5 base models (its 4B and 9B models are on the board) and keeps each question isolated from the others after the shared text; Laya [ 5 ] , a non-autoregressive engine on ModernBERT-large and mmBERT-base encoders, reads a question’s options together in one input; decider-2b [ 6 ] and open-jev [ 7 ] are further open models. Answers of large language models (LLMs) change when options are reordered [ 8 ] . On HakemBench’s permutation probe, order sensitivity among the other measured models runs from 0.039 (Jev 1.13) to 0.590 (Laya) [ 2 ] . Set-LLM [ 9 ] gives a pretrained decoder a mask and position encoding under which set elements neither see each other nor differ in position, proves invariance and reports no accuracy cost, while scoring options in isolation did not reliably raise accuracy in multiple-choice evaluation [ 10 ] . Supervised fine-tuning gave better calibration than reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards on decision tasks [ 11 ] ; we selected on validation loss after temperature scaling [ 15 ] and calibrated afterwards, as Berta et al. recommend [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们遵循Jev的公共合同[3]:最多255个选择问题选项和2到10个命令等级的分数问题选项。 Kev [4] 列车低档适配器和一个指向器头在Qwen3.5基型上(它的4B和9B型型号在板上),并在共享文本后将每个问题与其它问题隔离; Laya [5],现代BERT大和mmBERT基型编码器上的一款非自动回转引擎,在一个输入中一并读出一个问题选项; decitor-2b [6]和open-jev [7]是进一步开放的模型. 大语言模型(LLMs)的答案在选项重排时会变化 [8]. 在Hakem Bench的穿透探测器上,在其他被测量的模型中,顺序灵敏度从0.039 (Jev 1.13)到0.590 (Laya) [2]. Set-LLM [9] 给一个预先经过训练的解码器一个口罩和位置编码,根据这个编码,设定的元素既不相见也不相异,证明了偏差,报告没有准确性成本,而孤立的评分选项并不能可靠地提高多选择评价的准确性[10]. 监督的微调比强化学习更能校正,对决策任务给予可核查的奖励[11];我们在温度缩放后选择了验证损失,随后进行了校正,如Berta等人。 建议[22]。

blocks.en: 2 Model
blocks.zh: 2 型号

blocks.en: ufakzeka-1-base [ 1 ] has 24 layers and hidden size 768, uses a Turkish tokeniser of 40,960 entries, was pretrained on 13.5B tokens and is read causally. Of the released file’s 182,494,466 parameters, 182,492,928 are the backbone’s, 769 the scoring layer’s and 769 an abstain layer’s that the release does not use; without the 31,457,280-parameter embedding matrix it has 151,037,186, ufakzeka-1’s “151M” convention.
blocks.zh: ufakzeka-1-base [1] 有24个地层并有隐藏大小的768个,使用40,960个条目的土耳其活字符号,在13.5B个活字符号上经过了预先的训练并被因果读取. 在公布的档案中,182 494 466个参数中,182 492 928个是主干,769个是积分层,769个是弃权层,释放时没有使用;没有31 457 280个参数的嵌入矩阵,它就有151 037 186个Ufakzeka-1的 " 151M " 公约。

blocks.en: A question is one sequence: a prefix holding the text, Soru: and the question, then each option as its own segment ( Seçenek: ⟨ \langle name ⟩ \rangle . ⟨ \langle description ⟩ \rangle ; a level as Düzey k k : … ; yes and no as Cevap: evet and Cevap: hayır ). The prefix holds at most 448 tokens and an option at most 48. The prefix attends only to itself and each option causally to the prefix and itself, never to another option, and every option starts at the position after the prefix. Each option’s hidden states are mean-pooled and scored by one linear layer, and a softmax runs over the options. Options are laid out sorted by their encoded text and scores are returned in the caller’s order, so even summation order cannot change a bit; the repository’s permutation test on the real weights demands bit-for-bit equality. More than ten options are split in sorted order into passes of ten under one softmax; since an option’s logit does not depend on its pass-mates, the split does not change the answer, and reordering changes the probabilities only by floating-point noise.
blocks.zh: 一个问题就是一个序列:一个前缀持有文本,Soru:和问题,然后每个选项作为自己的部分(Seçenek:\\ langle name \\\rangle ). &\langle 描述 &\rangle ; 级别为 Düzey k k : ...; 是和否为 Cevap: evarat 和 Cevap: hayır 。 前缀最多有448个符,最多有48个选项. 前缀只面向自身和每个选项因果面向前缀和自身,从不面向其他选项,每个选项从前缀后的位置开始. 每个选项的隐藏状态都是平分的,并被一个线性层打出分数,一个软max贯穿在选项上. 选项按其被编码的文本排序,并按调用者的顺序返回分数,因此即使总和顺序也不能稍有改变;寄存器在实际权重上的排列测试要求位对位平等. 超过10个选项按排序顺序被分到一个软马克斯下的10个通路;由于一个选项的登录不依赖于它的通路同位素,分出不会改变答案,重新排序只能通过浮点噪声来改变概率.

blocks.en: Cross-entropy against each row’s target distribution, soft where labellers disagreed, plus on score questions the ranked probability score [ 17 ] , so mass two levels off costs more than one; both are strictly proper. Rows are weighted to each task’s natural answer mix; no reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh: 与每一行的目标分布相对应,在标签者意见不一的地方比较柔软,在分数问题上加上排名概率分数[17],所以质量两等离分成本都不止一个;两者严格来说都是适当的. 列是按每个任务的自然答案组合加权的;没有强化学习。

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en: Training data comes only from sources under Apache-2.0, MIT, CC0, CC BY 2.0 or CC BY 4.0, or written for the project; a licence manifest lists every file and the build fails on a missing or disallowed entry. Converted labelled sets keep their own labels, 3,000 rows each in the released mix: MASSIVE 1.1 in Turkish [ 32 ] (CC BY 4.0), the Turkish OffensEval 2020 corpus [ 33 ] (annotations CC BY 2.0), MiDe22 [ 34 ] (MIT), Constitutional Court individual-application decisions [ 35 ] (CC BY 4.0), FACTurk [ 36 ] (MIT) and WebFAQ [ 42 ] (collection CC BY 4.0, labelled from page structure). Three prompt-injection sets [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] (CC BY 4.0 and Apache-2.0; 1,791 rows) are labelled by the class each text was written or translated for. The released run added a conversational prompt-injection set (CC BY 4.0; 530 rows) whose texts are synthetic, model-written and curated by its author [ 40 ] . For some sources the licence covers the collection, while the rights to the individual texts stay with their authors or the sites that published them.
blocks.zh: 培训数据只来自Apache-2.0、MIT、CC0、CC BY 2.0或CC BY 4.0下的资料来源,或为该项目撰写;许可证清单列出每个文件,而且一个缺失或不允许的条目的建设失败。 已转换的标签集保留自己的标签, 释放的组合中各有3,000行 : MASSSIVE 1.1 in Turk [32] (CC BY 4.0),土耳其OffensEval 2020 acident [33] (注释CC BY 2.0),MiDe22 [34] (MIT),宪法法院个人申请裁决 [35] (CC BY 4.0),FACTurk [36] (MIT)和WebFAQ [42] (Collection CC BY 4.0 从页面结构上标出). 三套即时注射 [37, 38, 39] (CC BY 4.0 and Apache-2.0; 1,791行) 由各文本被写作或翻译的类标. 发行的跑曲增加了一个对话即时注射集(CC BY 4.0;530行),其文本由作者合成,模型写作并整理[40]. 对于某些来源来说,许可证涵盖收藏,而个人文本的权利则保留在作者或出版这些文本的网站。

blocks.en: For customer support, question templates in eight families (topic, urgency, handover to a person and others), written by various LLMs, were applied to 6,000 question-and-answer pairs from Turkish FAQ and community pages in clips/mqa [ 41 ] (collection CC0 1.0), 5,489 of them after a later filter, giving 12,957 training rows. The target is the mean of the probability vectors of two judge models from two families, read with the options rotated; they agreed on the top answer on 81 percent of training rows, and on the 255 development questions the panel agreed with the human answers on 75.3 percent [69.8, 80.4]. The human answers come from one person, the author; one annotator makes mistakes too, so figures that rest on them are indicative. The four support questions HakemBench asks of every support item (2,311 evaluation rows) were held out of Run 1’s training to test generalisation to unseen questions; Run 1 saw their three families only in other question types. Generated tracks (spam and phishing messages, student answers, court-routing scenes, posts with and without checkable claims; 10,250 rows) were written by two models and labelled by two LLM judges other than the writer (1,531 check-worthiness rows ask about FACTurk claims or clips/mqa questions instead), since we found no licensed human-labelled Turkish set for them. Every file was checked against 70 evaluation sets (328,398 items) and every HakemBench v1.0 item, probe and development text, by shared 8-grams and MinHash near-duplicates [ 31 ] in both directions, and flagged rows were removed. The mix takes at most 3,000 rows a task. Run 1 trained on 42,998 rows and Run 2 on 55,870; Run 3, the released run, trained on 55,679, 12,151 of them from Run 2’s additions.
blocks.zh: 对于客户支持,8个家庭(专题、紧迫性、向一人及其他人移交)的问题模板(由各种LLMs编写)被应用到6 000个土耳其FAQ和社区网页的短片/mqa[41](Collection CC0 1.0)中,其中5 489个经过后期过滤,提供了12 957个培训行。 目标是两个家庭的两个法官模型的概率矢量的平均值,与选项一起旋转;他们同意81%的培训行的顶端答案,关于255个发展问题,小组同意75.3%的人的答案[69.8,80.4]. 人类的答案来自一个人,即作者;一个注释者也会犯错误,因此,依靠这些答案的数字是指示性的。 Hakem Bench对每个支持项目(2,311个评价行)提出的四个支持性问题,都是在Run 1的训练之外举行的,以测试对隐形问题的概括;Run 1只看到他们的三个家庭在其他类型的问题中。 制作的曲目(垃圾邮件和打字留言、学生回答、法庭路线场景、有和没有可核查的主张的帖子;10 250行)由两个模型编写,并由两位LLM评委贴上标签,但作者除外(1 531行的可核查性栏则询问FACTurk的主张或剪辑/mqa问题),因为我们发现没有为其设置有许可证的人标注的土耳其语套装。 每个文件都与70套评价(328 398件)和每套Hakem Bench v1.0项、探测和开发文本核对,共享8克和MinHash两相近复制[31],并删除了标有标记的行。 混合体最多需要3000行的任务. 跑出一行训练42,998行,跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出一行跑出行跑出行跑出一行跑出行跑出行跑出行跑出行跑出

blocks.en: 4 Training and selection
blocks.zh: 4 培训和甄选

blocks.en: AdamW [ 14 ] , learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} for the backbone and 10 − 3 10^{-3} for the head, weight decay 0.01, 6 percent linear warm-up then linear decay, gradient clipping at 1.0, 32 questions a step, 2 epochs. The released run took 3,480 steps on one NVIDIA H200, with 427.8 seconds of training, 692.9 seconds in all and 13.5 GB peak memory. Every recipe ran with three random seeds; seeds and checkpoints were chosen on a support development set of 255 support questions with human answers, kept apart from the test set. Two earlier development rounds served the ablations (Section 7 ); Table 1 compares the three runs scored on HakemBench, Runs 1 to 3. Run 1 was trained on the data as cleaned when the benchmark was frozen, never on the held-out support questions, and scored before anything was published. Its results on the full test set were read; on guardrails it caught 205 of 217 attacks but passed only 70 of 201 harmless look-alikes (attack-like messages).
blocks.zh: 亚当W[14],骨干学习率10−4 10×4}和头部学习率10−3 10×3}体重衰减0.01,线性暖化率6%再线性衰减,梯度剪接1.0,32个问题一阶,两个历程. 发布跑道在一款NVIDIA H200上走出3,480步,训练了427.8秒,总共692.9秒和13.5GB峰值记忆. 每个食谱都有三种随机种子;种子和检查站被选在一套由255个支持性问题组成的支持性发展问题集上,与测试组分开。 早先的两轮开发都服务于平分(第7节);表1比较了哈克姆奔克的三跑得分,跑出一比三. 跑一号在被冻结基准时接受了数据清理的培训,从未在被搁置的支持问题上被打分,并在任何内容发布前打分. 其全部测试结果被读取;在护栏上,它捕获了217起袭击中的205起,但仅通过了201起无害外观(类似攻击的信息)中的70起.

blocks.en: added data aimed at Run 1’s errors on the full test set in guardrails, moderation and customer support. It asked the four support questions on 2,697 texts from the training pool and 300 from the validation pool, labelled by two AI models of one family, added 800 harmless guardrail messages in twenty product contexts (721 for training, 79 for validation), and added 1,499 comments (899 offensive, 600 clean) labelled blind by a model other than their writer. Run 2 passed its acceptance check (0.991 macro F1 on 224 validation rows of the earlier prompt-injection sets; Run 1 0.982), yet on HakemBench it caught only 106 of 217 attacks and passed 195 of 201 look-alikes. Every training attack was a template or a short translated prompt, and the only guardrail texts in a real user’s register were Run 2’s harmless ones: a likely register shortcut [ 28 ] , invisible to a check drawn from the same sets as the training attacks. Run 2’s data has three costs. The new support questions are the four held-out questions, and the held-out file shares 887 of its 937 texts with the validation pool, so support is no longer a generalisation test. Their labels come from the AI model family that settled the benchmark’s support gold under the same rubric, so a support score there is partly agreement with the labeller. And the new comments resemble the benchmark’s model-written moderation items, all in the open set (a style check: a character n-gram classifier trained on them reached 0.926 balanced accuracy on those items but 0.401 on web-sourced moderation texts, against 0.818 and 0.619 for one trained on the older rows), so the moderation results of Runs 2 and 3 may read too high.
blocks.zh: 提供更多数据, 它就来自培训池的2,697个文本和来自认证池的300个文本提出了四个支持性问题,由一个家庭的两个AI模型标出,在20个产品背景(721个用于培训,79个用于验证)中增加了800个无害的护栏信息,并增加了1,499个评论(899个攻击性,600个干净),其作者以外的模型标出盲文。 跑2号通过了它的接受检查(在较早的快速注射套装的224个验证行上为0.991个宏F1;跑1 0.982),然而在哈克姆本奇号上却只捕获了217起攻击中的106起并通过了201起外观相像的195起. 每次训练攻击都是一个模板或一个简短的翻译提示,真正的用户登记册中唯一的护卫文本是Run 2的无害文本:一个可能的登记捷径[28],从训练攻击中抽取的同一套支票看不见。 运行2的数据有三种成本. 新的支持问题为被搁置的4个问题,被搁置的文件与验证池共享其937个文本中的887个,因此支持已不再是泛化测试. 他们的标签来自在同一个标题下结算基准支持金的AI模型家族,因此那里的支持分数部分与标签者一致. 新的评论与基准的模型写作节制项目相似,都是开放式的(样式检查:在这些项目上受过训练的正克字符分类器在这些项目上达到了0.926的平衡准确度,而在网络来源的节制文本上达到了0.401,而在旧行上受过训练的则达到了0.818和0.619),因此Runs 2和3的节制结果可能读取过高。

blocks.en: Run 2’s guardrail results on the full test set were read, and they showed the shortcut. Because training again after seeing test results weakens what the test measures, the protocol of Run 3 was fixed in writing before any of its data, code or runs; the selection rule and its result ship with the code. It added the train split of the conversational prompt-injection set [ 40 ] and made its validation and test splits (50 attacks, 170 harmless messages) a guardrail development set. Two variants ran with three random seeds each, one with half of Run 2’s 721 harmless look-alike rows and one without them. A run qualified if it caught at least 80 percent of the development attacks (yes probability at least 0.5); the qualifying run with the highest macro F1 on the support development set would be scored once, with no tuning after it. Four of six runs qualified and the rule chose a run without the look-alike rows, which caught 42 of 50 development attacks (recall 0.84 [0.725, 0.933]), passed 161 of 170 harmless messages and reached a development macro F1 of 0.688. Every number of Run 3 therefore comes after two readings of the test results, Run 1’s in all three targeted tracks and Run 2’s in guardrails, so its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers carry the flag “shaped by reading the test results”.
blocks.zh: 运行2号护栏的测试结果被读取, 由于在看到测试结果后再次训练会削弱测试措施,因此"跑跑3"的协议在它的任何数据,代码或跑跑之前都是书面固定的;选择规则及其结果飞船与代码. 它又增加了对话即时注射装置的列车分拆[40],并使得其验证和测试分拆(50起攻击,170起无害消息)成为了护栏发展装置. 两个变种各有3个随机种子出跑,一个是跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑 如果至少抓取了80%的开发攻击(是概率至少为0.5),则跑步合格;在支持开发集上成绩最高的宏F1的合格跑跑将得一分,之后再无调子. 6跑有4个合格,规则选择了没有外观相近一行的跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑 因此,每个运行3号的编号都是在两次读取测试结果之后,运行1号在全部三个定向轨道上,运行2号在护栏上,因此其护栏、节制和客户支持号都悬挂着 " 通过读取测试结果而成 " 的旗帜。

blocks.en: 5 Calibration
blocks.zh: 5 校准

blocks.en: Validation rows were split 80/20 by a hash of the text into fit and selection parts, development items removed. Temperature scaling [ 15 ] in four forms (none, global, per question type, per type and option-count bucket) was fitted by cross-entropy on the fit part, and the form with the lowest cross-entropy on the selection part was chosen, preferring a simpler form within 0.001: for the released run one global T = 1.2614 T=1.2614 . The “not sure” value is the expected error given the raw maximum probability, an isotonic map [ 18 ] fitted on the selection part, the error being one minus the target’s mass on the model’s answer. No other confidence score beat maximum probability [ 19 ] in a check on an earlier checkpoint (area under the generalised risk-coverage curve, AUGRC, 0.1635 against 0.1642 for DOCTOR [ 20 ] ), in line with Traub et al. [ 24 ] . We report the Brier score [ 16 ] and the smooth expected calibration error (smooth ECE) [ 23 ] , a kernel-smoothed gap between stated confidence and observed accuracy; lower is better.
blocks.zh: 校验行被将80/20用散列的文本分割成适合和选择的部分,开发项目被删除. 温度缩放[15]分四种形式(无一,全局,每个问题类型,每个类型和选项计数桶)由适中部分的交叉收缩相接而成,选择选择了选择部分中交叉收缩最低的形态,更倾向于在0.001内采用更简单的形态:对于被放放放放的跑道,一个全球T=1.2614 T=1.2614. " 不确定 " 值是预期的误差,因为原始的最大概率是选取部分的同位素地图[18],误差是乘以模型答案上的目标质量。 在检查一个较早的检查站时,没有其他信心分数比起最大概率[19](一般风险覆盖曲线下的区域,AUGRC,0.1635对DOCTOR[20]0.1642),与Traub等人一致. [24]. 我们报告布赖尔分数[16]和平滑预期校正出错(smooth ECE)[23],这是所声明的自信和所观察到的准确性之间的内核平滑差距;下调更好.

blocks.en: Table 1: The three training runs scored on HakemBench (Run 3 is released): composite on the open set (Section 6 ) with its 95 percent bootstrap interval, guardrail attacks caught (of 217) and harmless look-alikes passed (of 201), accuracy on the human check (84 support questions answered by hand without seeing the labels), each run’s own temperature T T (Run 1 fitted one per question type: 1.2341 for choice, 1.4003 for yes or no and 1.0507 for score questions), and smooth ECE (lower is better) without (raw) and with T T on the 2,311 held-out support rows, whose four questions Run 1 never trained on and Runs 2 and 3 did, and on the support development set (dev. set).
blocks.zh: 表1:在Hakem Bench(Run 3发布)上进行的三次培训得分:露天集(第6节)上的复合材料,其95%的靴子间隔被捕获(217起)和无害外观类似物被传递(201起),人机检查的准确性(84个支持问题在未看到标签的情况下得到手接答),每个运行的温度T(Run 1装有1个问题类型:选择1.2341起,是或否1.4003起,分数问题1.0507起),以及平稳的欧洲经委会(较好),没有(抽取),2 311起支持行上的T,其4个问题跑1从未受过训练,跑出3起,以及支持开发(Dev. set)。

blocks.en: Temperature scaling makes calibration worse on a set of held-out support questions: for Run 1, which never trained on them, its own temperature raises smooth ECE from 0.027 to 0.045 (Table 1 ). The released model later trained on those four questions (Runs 2 and 3 add them), and its temperature was fitted on validation rows that ask those questions on texts from the same pool, so its own rise from 0.036 to 0.064 on that set (Brier 0.274 to 0.278) is not an unseen-question test; Run 2 moves the same way, and no interval was computed for these changes. On the support development set the temperature lowers the released model’s calibration error from 0.050 to 0.038. A likely reason is that a temperature fitted on mildly overconfident validation data overcorrects on questions at a different confidence level. The selection rule was fixed before the held-out result was seen, so T = 1.2614 T=1.2614 ships as chosen; T = 1 T=1 would have kept its held-out calibration error at 0.036. On the benchmark the model stays somewhat overconfident (the post-hoc temperature the benchmark fits for it is 1.1733).
blocks.zh: 在一系列搁置支持问题上,温度缩放使校正更加糟糕:对于从未受过训练的跑一号,它自身的温度将欧洲经委会平稳地从0.027升至0.045(表1)。 释放的模型后来就这四个问题进行了培训(Runs 2和3添加了它们),它的温度被安装在从同一个集合中向文本中询问这些问题的验证行上,所以它自己从0.036上升到了0.064的该集(Brier 0.274到0.278)并不是一个隐性的问题测试;运行2以同样的方式移动,没有计算这些变化的间隔. 在支持开发上设置了温度将所释放的模型的校正误差从0.050降至0.038. 一个可能的原因是,在轻度过度自信的验证数据上安装的温度在不同的置信水平上对问题过于正确。 选择规则在看到被搁置结果之前是固定的,因此T=1.2614 T=1.2614所选择的舰只;T=1 T=1本可以将其被搁置的校正误差保持在0.036. 在基准上,模型保持了某种程度的过度自信(高温后的基准是1.1733)。

blocks.en: With confidence read as one minus the not-sure value, a threshold of 0.9 lets through 0.292 of the 4,275 open questions (1,248), and 0.062 of those answers are wrong. At 0.99 the error is higher, 0.085 on 213 answers: 148 of them are guardrail answers, 18 of those are wrong (0.122, Wilson interval [ 30 ] 0.078 to 0.184), and no other track has an error there. The signal cannot be relied on to catch guardrail errors. On customer support almost no answer reaches 0.9 (6 of 1,340). No other interval was computed for these figures.
blocks.zh: 如果信心读作一个减去不确定值,那么在4 275个未决问题(1 248个)和0.062个答案中,0.9的门槛值通过0.292的门槛值是错误的。 在0.99时误差较高,213个答题上为0.085:其中148个是护卫接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题接题 不能依赖信号来捕捉护栏错误。 在客户支助方面,几乎没有答复者达到0.9人(1 340人中有6人)。 这些数字没有计算出其他间隔。

blocks.en: 6 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6. 评价

blocks.en: The results below are those of the released model, Run 3. As Section 4 describes, its numbers are not blind: every one comes after readings of the first two runs’ results on the full test set, and its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers carry the flag “shaped by reading the test results”. Figures are on HakemBench’s open set unless the text names another set.
blocks.zh: 以下为所发布模型"跑出3"的成绩. 正如第4节所描述的那样,其数字不是盲目的:每个数字都是在读完全部测试结果后发出的,其护栏、节制和客户支持数字都标有 " 通过读完测试结果而成 " 的旗帜。 除非文字名称为另一套。

blocks.en: The open set of HakemBench v1.0 [ 2 ] holds 2,346 items and 4,275 questions in seven tracks. Most gold was settled by passes of AI models, and 260 questions carry human-decided gold. The composite, by which the public leaderboard (the board) ranks models, is the equally weighted geometric mean of three axes averaged over tracks: decision quality (macro F1; “intelligence” in the board files), calibration (Brier score relative to the uniform guess) and selective automation (AUGRC relative to a model wrong on every question). Intervals, unless named otherwise, are 95 percent percentile intervals from 2,000 bootstrap resamples over items, the same for every model; hosted models were queried on 26 and 27 September 2026 (UTC). Some named hosted models share a family with models that wrote or labelled parts of the benchmark data, and the companion paper also scores every model on the human-decided gold.
blocks.zh: Hakem Bench v1.0 [2] 的开口套装有2,346个物品和4,275个问题分出7道. 大多数黄金是通过AI型号的通行证来安顿下来的,260个问题携带了人类决定的黄金. 由公共领跑板(指跑板)排列模型的复合材料是三个轴的等同加权几何平均值:决定质量(macro F1;指跑板文件中的"智能"),校准(比得分相对于统一猜想)和有选择地自动化(指每个问题的模型错误). 除别名外,间隔时间从2,000个靴子上重新印出95%的间隔,每个模型相同;2026年9月26日和27日询问了主机模型(UTC)。 一些被命名为主机的模型与一些模型共享一个家族,这些模型会写出或标出基准数据的一部分,而相伴的论文也会在人定金上给每个模型打分.

blocks.en: Table 2: HakemBench v1.0 public board on the open set; axes as defined in the text, higher is better; interval: 95 percent bootstrap interval of the composite. Median ms: per question in the board run, not part of the composite, on setups that differ (a Mac CPU for ufakzeka-karar, open-jev and Laya at shipped length; an NVIDIA L4 GPU for Kev, Qwen3.5-4B and decider-2b; a GPU for Laya at full length; the network for hosted models; the surface-cue baseline runs no neural network, so its time is 0.0). Surface-cue baseline: a simple reference model we added for comparison that answers from cues such as length, digits or a question mark, not from meaning. max_len: input length in tokens.
blocks.zh: 表 2: Hakem Bench v1.0 公用板在开放的相机上; 文本中定义的轴, 更高则更好; 间隔: 组合件的靴子间隔为95%. 中间 ms:每个问题在板上运行,而不是复合体的一部分,关于不同的设置(一个被运出长度的ufakzeka-karar,open-jev和Laya的Mac CPU;一个被运出长度的Kev,Quen3.5-4B和决定器-2b的NVIDIA L4 GPU;一个全长的Laya的GPU;主机模型的网络;表面-cue基线运行没有神经网络,因此时间为0.0. 平面-曲线基线:我们为比较而添加的一个简单的参考模型,它来自诸如长度、数字或问号之类的提示,而不是意义。 max_len:以符号输入长度.

blocks.en: ufakzeka-karar ranks 7th (Table 2 ). Three hosted chat models (Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6 Sol, GLM 5.3) and the decision API Jev 1.13 lead clearly (0.825 to 0.888), and Kev 4B and Kev 9B also score higher; the intervals of ranks 5 to 9 overlap its own, so that band is not settled. Its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers are flagged. With every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16 (no interval). On decision quality alone it is also behind Qwen3.5-4B (0.741) and DeepSeek V4 Pro (0.761), and on calibration (0.482) it is close to Kev 4B (0.503). DeepSeek V4 Pro’s probabilities were read from its option labels’ log-probabilities, so its calibration axis (0.386) reflects that route as well as the model.
blocks.zh: 乌法克泽卡-卡尔排名第7(表2.). 三种主机聊天模式(Gemini 3.8 Flash,GPT 5.6 Sol,GLM 5.3)和决定API Jev 1.13领先明显(0.825至0.888),而Kev 4B和Kev 9B的得分也较高;排名5到9的间隔与自己的相重叠,因此乐队没有定下. 其护栏、节制和客户支助号被标出。 由于每个型号只在其他四道赛道上得分,其复合分数为0.678分,为16分之6(无间隔). 就决定质量而言,它也落后于Quen3.5-4B(0.741)和DeepSeek V4 Pro(0.761),就校正(0.482)而言,它接近于Kev 4B(0.503)。 深搜索 V4 Pro的概率从其选项标签的对数概率中读出,因此它的校正轴(0.386)既反映了这个路线,也反映了模型.

blocks.en: Accuracy runs from 0.569 [0.534, 0.605] on customer support (1,340 questions; like guardrails and moderation, a flagged track) and 0.640 on fact-check triage to 0.952 on moderation; the public board file in the code repository gives every board model’s macro F1 by track. The weakest places are the support choice and score questions (accuracy 0.490 and 0.481) and the triage priority scale (0.500, macro F1 0.268). The guardrail track has the highest calibration error, a smooth ECE of 0.158 against 0.025 to 0.084 on the other tracks; the model catches 194 of 217 attacks and passes 128 of 201 harmless look-alikes. On moderation it catches 150 of 157 offensive messages and passes 186 of 196 clean ones (see the style caveat of Section 4 ). The 181 court items and the 28 guardrail items taken from public prompt-injection sets are the test splits of datasets whose train splits are in ufakzeka-karar’s training data (3,000 court rows, and 1,791 rows from three prompt-injection sets that include the guardrail items’ two source sets; near-duplicates removed), so on those questions the model is supervised in-distribution while the other models answer zero-shot; its legal routing score (macro F1 0.754) and the guardrail counts should be read with that.
blocks.zh: 准确度从客户支持的0.569 [0.534,0.605] (1,340个问题;如护栏和节制,标出道)和事实检查的0.640到节制的0.952;代码存储库中的公用板文件逐道给出了每个板模型的宏F1. 最弱的地方是支持选择和分数问题(准确性为0.490和0.481)和分数优先等级(0.500,宏F10.268)。 护栏轨道的校正误差最大,在其它轨道上,欧洲经委会的平滑度为0.158比0.025到0.084;模型捕获了217起攻击中的194起,超过201起无害外观型中的128起。 在节制方面,它收到157个攻击性信息中的150个,196个干净信息中的186个(见第4节的风格警告)。 从公共即时注射装置取自的181个法院物品和28个护栏物品是列车分出在ufakzeka-kar的训练数据中的数据集的测试分数(3 000个法院用行,以及3个即时注射装置中的1 791个行,其中包括护栏物品的两个源数;几乎复制件被取出),因此在这些问题上,模型受到监督的分散,而其他模型则回答零发;其法定路线分数(macro F1 0.754)和护栏计数应随此读取。

blocks.en: The surface-cue baseline answers from cues such as length, digits or a question mark, not from meaning. Over the whole open set it beats ufakzeka-karar on the support choice (0.516 against 0.490) and score questions (0.507 against 0.481), partly in-sample, as its cues were fitted on part of the open set. On the 84 support questions of the human check, answered by hand without seeing the labels, the model’s accuracy is 0.476 [0.369, 0.583], below the baseline’s 0.619 [0.512, 0.714], while the three leading hosted chat models and Jev 1.13 score 0.738 to 0.786 and DeepSeek V4 Pro 0.583.
blocks.zh: 表面- cue 基线从长度,数字或问号等提示中解答,而不是从意义中解答. 整个开放场面在支持选择(0.516对0.490)上击败了Ufakzeka-karar(0.507对0.481),因为其提示部分安装在开放场面上。 在人类检查的84个支持问题上,在没有看到标签的情况下用手回答,模型的精度为0.476 [0.369,0.583],低于基线的0.619 [0.512,0.714],而三大主机聊天模式和Jev 1.13的得分为0.738分到0.786分和DeepSeek V4 Pro 0.583分.

blocks.en: The model’s order sensitivity is 0.000 by construction. Half of its robustness value (0.941 [0.917, 0.966], Jev 1.13 0.943) is therefore 1.0 by construction; on the measured half, paraphrase agreement, it is 0.883 [0.833, 0.932] against Jev’s 0.926 [0.889, 0.963], intervals overlapping. The English Brier gap (Turkish minus English Brier score; negative means worse in English) is − 0.303 -0.303 [ − 0.377 -0.377 , − 0.225 -0.225 ]; it was not trained for English. On an Apple M1 with one PyTorch thread and 13 sample questions, the model took a median of 102.5 ms a question (69.8 to 194.5 ms) with peak resident memory of 986,038,272 bytes in 32-bit floating point (fp32).
blocks.zh: 该模型的订单敏感度为0. 因此,其坚固值的一半(0.941 [0.917,0.966],Jev 1.13 0.943)通过构造为1.0;在所测量的一半上,从解释协议来看,它相对于Jev的0.926 [0.889,0.963],间隔重叠. 英格蘭布列爾差分(土耳其分减英格蘭布列爾分數;負分指更糟糕的英语分数)为−0.303-0.303 [−0.377-0.377,−0.225-0.225];它没有接受过英语训练. 在一款有PyTorch线程和13个样本问题的苹果M1上,模型取取了中位数为102.5 ms a question (69.8至194.5 ms),最高峰活性记忆为986,038,272字节在32位浮点(fp32).

blocks.en: Each item was asked as a typed question with no examples and scored with each run’s own calibration (Table 3 ). The MASSIVE, MiDe22 and OffensEval numbers are supervised, not zero-shot: their train splits are in the training data. MMLU-Pro-TR [ 45 , 46 ] , XCOPA [ 43 ] and X-FACT [ 44 ] touch no training text, though all of X-FACT’s Turkish claims come from Doğruluk Payı, one of FACTurk’s sources. From Run 1 to Run 3 accuracy fell a little on the first four sets and rose on XCOPA and X-FACT; the intervals overlap on every set, and no paired test was run. On the knowledge exam MMLU-Pro-TR the released model is slightly below chance: 0.098 [0.092, 0.103] against 0.111.
blocks.zh: 每件物品都作为打字问题被问到,没有实例,并按每跑的校正(表3)打分。 MASSIVE,MiDe22和OffensEval的车次被监督,而不是零发:他们的列车分出在训练数据中. MMLU-Pro-TR [45,46],XCOPA[43]和X-FACT[44]没有触及培训文本,尽管X-FACT的所有土耳其索赔都来自FACTurk的消息来源之一Doğruluk Payı. 从"跑一"到"跑三"的精度在前四套上稍有下降,在"XCOPA"和"X-FACT"上上升;每套上的间隔重叠,没有进行对接测试. 在知识考试MMLU-Pro-TR上,所放出的模式略低于概率:0.098 [0.092,0.103]对0.111.

blocks.en: Table 3: External Turkish test sets, Run 1 and Run 3 (released), each with its own temperature; n n : rows scored; chance: accuracy of a uniform guess; Run 3 interval: 95 percent bootstrap interval of Run 3’s accuracy; the first three sets are supervised (their train splits are in the training data; MiDe22 ships as one file, so its 70/10/20 split was drawn by the project before training); X-FACT is asked as Cetvel’s four verdicts; OffensEval-TR 2020 A is subtask A, offensive or not. Dropped: 37 repeated MASSIVE test utterances, 2 MiDe22 rows overlapping training texts and 4 malformed MMLU-Pro-TR rows.
blocks.zh: 表3:土耳其外部测试集,跑出1和跑出3(发布),每组都有自己的温度;n:行得分;概率:一个统一猜测的准确度;跑出3间隔:跑出3的准确度的95%;前三组被监督(他们的列车分出在训练数据中;MiDe22舰艇作为一个文件,因此其70/10/20分出在训练前由项目绘制);X-FACT作为Cetvel的四个判决被询问;OffensEval-TR 2020 A是次任务A,攻击与否。 被放弃:37个重复的MASSIVE测试语句,2个米德22行相重叠的训练文本和4个变形的MMLU-Pro-TR行.

blocks.en: 7 Ablations
blocks.zh: 7项

blocks.en: Every ablation’s compared choices (arms), measures and decision rule were fixed in writing before it ran; each training arm used three random seeds and was judged by a paired bootstrap over items within each task and over seeds, and the int8 files, built from one checkpoint, were compared with fp32 on the same rows (Table 4 ); for the head and objective arms the primary measure was macro F1 on the held-out questions, which neither the second development round nor Run 1 trained on, with calibration measures as secondary outcomes under a Holm correction [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 每一条对比的选择(武器)、措施和决定规则在运行前都以书面形式确定;每条训练臂使用三个随机种子,并在每项任务和种子上用一双靴子来判断,从一个检查站建造的Int8文件与同行的fp32文件(表4);对头和客观臂来说,主要措施是关于搁置问题的宏观F1, 既不是第二轮发展回合,也不是第1跑的训练,在Holm修正下,校正措施作为次要结果[29]。

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablations: the compared choice minus the shipped one in macro F1 points (hundredths of the 0 to 1 scale), unless stated. The conversion row ran in a first head trial on the causal backbone (general sets: MASSIVE, OffensEval and MiDe22), the BERTurk, MoganBert-TR and continued-pretraining rows in the first development round, the easy-row and int8 (8-bit integer weights) rows in the second, and the sequential-head and REINFORCE rows in Run 1 and the second round, as marked.
blocks.zh: 表4:除说明外,比对选择数减去在宏F1分数(0至1分数的百分数)中运出的一个。 转换行在因果主干上进行第一次头接试(一般赛制:MASSIVE,OffensEval和MiDe22),BERTurk,MoganBert-TR和继续预训行在首发开发回合中跑出,易行和倒数8(8位整数重)行在第二发,相继跑出一发和倒数2发,如所标出.

blocks.en: The backbone had been fixed as the lab’s own before the encoder comparisons, so those are reported, not acted on. The sequential head’s four-point loss in the second development round did not reproduce in Run 1, trained on cleaned data, so we claim only the smaller result, that the order-invariant head is as accurate and never depends on option order. REINFORCE (eight samples a question, the target’s mass on the sampled answer as reward) has an expected reward linear in the probabilities, so its optimum puts all mass on one answer; cross-entropy’s minimiser is the target. No int8 file stayed within the required 0.5 points of fp32 on macro F1, even with the 24 feed-forward down-projection matrices in fp32; the loss came from near-tie answers, so the release is fp32.
blocks.zh: 在对编码器进行比较之前,骨干已固定为实验室的自用,因此,报告时没有采取行动。 在第二回合开发过程中, 相继头部的四分损失并没有在 Run 1 中重现, REINFORCE(一个问题有8个样本,目标的质量在被抽样的答案上作为奖励)在概率上有一个预期的奖励线性,因此它的最佳效果是将所有的质量放在一个答案上;跨热带的最小值是目标。 没有int8文件停留在宏F1上要求的0.5分fp32范围内,即使有fp32中的24个feed-forward- down-projection矩阵;损失来自近接的答案,所以发布为fp32.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: Six models on the board score higher. Support routing is weak: on the 84 support questions of the human check, the model is below the surface-cue baseline. All human answers come from one person; there is no inter-annotator agreement. Calibration does not transfer everywhere, and the not-sure signal misses guardrail errors. Every number of the released model comes after readings of earlier runs’ test results, and its guardrail, moderation and support numbers are flagged. It passes only 128 of 201 harmless look-alikes. The moderation result may be inflated by style likeness. World knowledge is weak; the model reads Turkish only, and the end of a text beyond 448 tokens is cut. Most training labels come from LLMs or rules, and no prompt-injection or relevance label was checked by a person. The board’s intervals resample items, but items a model wrote in one generation request are correlated, so they are likely too narrow.
blocks.zh: 板上6个型号得分较高. 支持路由薄弱:在人类检查的84个支持问题上,模型低于地表-cue基线. 所有的人的答案都来自一个人;没有通知人之间的协议。 校正不会随地转移,不确定信号会漏掉护栏错误. 每个公布的模型都是在读取了早先运行的测试结果之后,并标出它的护栏、节制和支撑数字。 它只通过了201种无害外观的128种. 温和的结果可能因风格相似而膨胀. 世界知识薄弱;模型只读土耳其语,超过448个令牌的文字被剪去. 大多数训练标签出自LLMS或规则,一个人没有检查过即时注射或相关标签. 棋盘的间隔重取项目,但在一代人的请求中写的模型项目是相互关联的,因此它们可能过于狭窄.

blocks.en: 9 Cost and release
blocks.zh: 9 费用和释放

blocks.en: The project cost $236.90 in GPU time and hosted model API calls ($181.55 on Modal, $55.35 in API calls). The figure does not include the server, the AI model used during development or the base model ufakzeka-1, whose cost is reported with it [ 1 ] . The figure covers the model and HakemBench together and was read from the providers’ dashboards.
blocks.zh: 该项目花费了GPU时间236.90美元,并托管了型号API呼叫(Modal为181.55美元,API为55.35美元). 图中不包括服务器,开发期间使用的AI模型或基模型ufakzeka-1,其成本随其上报 [1]. 该数字包括模型和Hakem Bench一起,从供应商的仪表板上读取。

blocks.en: An AI model was used throughout this project to write and run the training, data and evaluation code, to review plans, items and texts, and to draft this report. AI models also wrote and labelled training data (Sections 3 and 4 ), and AI passes settled most of HakemBench’s gold and reviewed its probes [ 2 ] . The human answers on the support development set and in the human check are the author’s own. The author directed the work, reviewed the results and text, and is responsible for all of it.
blocks.zh: 在整个项目中,都使用AI模式来编写和运行培训、数据和评价守则,审查计划、项目和案文并起草本报告。 AI模型也写作并标注了训练数据(第3和4节),AI通过安放了Hakem Bench的大部分黄金并检讨了它的探测器[2]. 支持开发的人类答案和人类检查是作者自己的。 作者指导了作品,审查了结果和文本,并对全部作品负责.
